name: Belief
overview: Belief in Scripture is presented as a vital trust in God's promises and in Jesus Christ as the Son of God, who offers salvation and eternal life to all who believe. The Scriptures encourage believers to place their faith firmly in God’s power to redeem and deliver, as seen in His promise to Israel in Exodus 6:6, and to trust Jesus even amid doubts, as the father in Mark 9:24 exemplifies. Belief also calls for active commitment, reflected in Christ’s command to preach the gospel to all and the assurance that those who believe will do greater works through Him (John 14:12). Ultimately, belief is both a personal assurance and a call to live out faith in obedience and witness.
